name: fl_seam_inspector
description: Ousterhout Deep Module and architectural seam analyzer. Calculates depth ratio (implementation complexity vs interface surface), detects shallow pass-through abstractions, audits adapter counts per seam, and evaluates the Deletion Test.
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

action.description: Action to perform: 'analyze_depth' (default, measures interface-to-implementation depth ratio), 'audit_seams' (detects adapters and verifies multi-adapter seam validity), or 'deletion_test' (estimates caller blast radius).

target_path.description: Path to file or directory to inspect for deep module architecture.

interface_symbol.description: Optional name of specific interface, type, or class symbol to target.

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear technical rationale explaining why this tool is called.
